description: A modern, flat-panel television set, depicted as a 3D model. The television features a dark gray, rectangular screen with a thin, black bezel. It is supported by two slender, light-colored metallic feet that extend from the bottom corners, giving it a stable base. The overall design is minimalist and sleek, characteristic of contemporary electronics. The object is rendered against a textured, gradient gray background, which could represent a concrete wall and floor, giving it a somewhat industrial or modern studio feel. Subtle black outlines on the edges of the TV and its stand give it a stylized, almost cel-shaded appearance, highlighting its contours.
